title: Google’s satellite AI server transmits its first response to Earth
summary: Google's AI chip-equipped satellite has generated its first response from space. In a blog post on Friday, Google says it successfully booted up the satellite's Tensor Processing Units (TPUs), allowing the on-board Gemma 4 model to follow through on a prompt to create a haiku abo
reason: Not a model release: 'Gemma 4' appears only as an on-orbit demo, with no announced model availability, new version, or new capability. Link is The Verge (not Google's official page) and linked_page_author/owner are not observed, so 1-1 is unmet; it's an infrastructure milestone, not a business event
